scope_statement: Blind authority research only. Reconstructs what the authorized repository surfaces establish about detector fvg semantics and causal authority across native bar scales. No behavioral research, no fill-rate analysis, no prediction testing, no strategy research, no raw-lake access, no peer inspection, and no shared-file edits were performed.
